operation.label: Sample raster, rules and the published comparison: Manila facilities against projected sea level

source: HOT export of OpenStreetMap health facilities, Philippines (ODbL 1.0); DeltaDTM v1.1 (doi:10.4121/21997565, CC BY 4.0); DTU25MSS (doi:10.11583/DTU.29412275, CC BY 4.0); EGM2008 from PROJ (cdn.proj.org, public domain); IPCC AR6 projections (doi:10.5281/zenodo.5914709, CC BY 4.0); via the example example-2026-sea-level-rise-philippines

declaredParameters.windows: Each grid kept as Raster input keeps it: the cells meeting the study area's bounding box, no padding. A grid published at nodes (EGM2008, DTU25MSS) is read as the cells around its nodes, half a cell out.

sampling.egm2008_m: bilinear between the four nearest node values, at the AR6 sites
sampling.mss_m: bilinear between the four nearest node values, at the AR6 sites
sampling.ground_m: the value of the DeltaDTM cell containing the facility; 30 is DeltaDTM's ceiling, kept as a value

declaredParameters.nearest: Each facility's nearest AR6 site by great-circle distance.

heights.sea_above_geoid_m: mss_m - egm2008_m at the nearest site

comparison.level: Reaches where margin_mm <= 0, StaysBelow where margin_mm > 0, Unknown otherwise

integrity.note: SHA-256 of this fixture with the integrity field removed, serialised with object keys sorted, no whitespace and UTF-8. Not the file's bytes: the lab reads fixtures through a transport that re-serialises JSON.
